name: ml-anomaly-detection
description: Use when the user asks about anomaly or outlier detection: Z-score/IQR baselines, Isolation Forest, LOF, autoencoders, time-series anomalies, fraud or sensor outliers and alert thresholds. Produces method choice by data type, model config and evaluation with labeled or synthetic anomalies. Not for data pipeline volume monitors (use data-data-observability).
